title: _workflow
description: A named definition, e.g. a requirements intake workflow. It is a trigger that creates tasks and assigns them automatically, made of an array of entries. Adapter: generates the Claude Code workflow from the _workflow entity, at the location Claude Code expects by convention (build step, like _role). Draft v0: the entry fields are not fully defined yet.

name.description: Name of the definition, e.g. "requirements intake workflow".

entries.description: May be omitted on input; normalization sets it to [].

trigger.description: Enum whose values are defined at project level. Not defined yet.
